subject: Re: Kickoff: DReG estimators in the LVM training toolkit
body:
Release decisions:

1. Toolkit ships May 22 (four days late — I'll own that upward) with DReG as the default inference-network estimator and the variance telemetry on by default. The order-of-magnitude variance reduction chart is the first thing in the docs.
2. Adopter two makes the release. The human-rating round on the compressed window came back 62/38 preferring the DReG-trained samples with decent inter-rater agreement (0.71) — enough to publish internally alongside the +0.9 nats number from adopter one.
3. Scope cut: the jackknife variant of the estimator stays out of v1. Csilla documents it as experimental.
4. The annotation UI graduates to a maintained tool under Saoirse — the rater-queue piece is obviously reusable for future evals, and I want it in our OKR story for the half.

Thanks all, genuinely tidy execution.

Zofia
